title: RQG Item - spiritMagic
description: Generated JSON Schema for the "spiritMagic" Item DataModel's `system` data. Source: src/data-model/item-data/spirit-magic-data-model.ts. Do not edit by hand — run `pnpm generate:schemas`.

points.title: Points
points.description: Magic points the spell costs, or its level.

castingRange.title: Casting range
castingRange.description: How far from the caster the spell can reach.

concentration.title: Concentration
concentration.description: Whether the caster has to concentrate on the spell while it lasts.

isRitual.title: Is ritual
isRitual.description: Whether the spell is cast as a ritual.

isEnchantment.title: Is enchantment
isEnchantment.description: Whether the spell is an enchantment.

resistedBy.title: Resisted by
resistedBy.description: What the target can resist the spell with.

targetKind.title: Target kind
targetKind.description: What the spell targets: for example a character, a weapon or an area.

effectTier.title: Effect tier
effectTier.description: How the system applies the spell effect: not at all, with an Active Effect, or with a macro.

passesSpellBarriers.title: Passes spell barriers
passesSpellBarriers.description: Set for spells that attack other spells' defences, like Dispel Magic and Dismiss Magic.

descriptionRqidLink.title: Description
descriptionRqidLink.description: Link to the journal entry that describes the spell.

effectRqidLink.title: Effect
effectRqidLink.description: Link to the Active Effect template applied when the spell is cast.

isVariable.title: Is variable
isVariable.description: Whether the spell can be cast at any number of points up to its maximum.

spellFocus.title: Spell focus
spellFocus.description: The object used to focus the spell, if any.

isMatrix.title: Held in matrix
isMatrix.description: Whether the spell is stored in a matrix.
